A '''Jedi Peacekeeper''' was one of the oldest and most common roles that a [[Jedi/Legends|member]] of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] could specialize in. Jedi Peacekeeper was a role within the [[Jedi Guardian/Legends|Jedi Guardian]] branch of the order.<ref name="FDCR">[[Star Wars: Force and Destiny Core Rulebook|''Star Wars: Force and Destiny'' Core Rulebook]]</ref> The ideal held by these individuals was compiled by the Guardian [[Jedi ace]] [[Crix Sunburris]] in the text, ''[[The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force]]''.<ref name="TJP" /> Many of them used [[Force lightning/Legends|Force lightning]] in their duties.<ref name="Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force real-life book">[[Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force (real-life book)|''Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force'']]</ref>

==Overview==
The group of Peacekeepers stationed on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] were based out of the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] and many worked for the [[Temple Security Force]]. Charged with protecting the Temple's occupants and treasures, they also watched over the [[Temple district/Legends|Temple Precinct]] and the civilians which called it their home.<ref name="TJP" />

Notable Peacekeepers included [[Jedi Gate Master]] [[Jurokk]]<ref name="EPIII">[[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith (novelization)|''Star Wars Episode III: Revenge of the Sith'']]</ref> and [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Tera Sinube/Legends|Tera Sinube]].<ref name="LL">{{TCW|Lightsaber Lost}}</ref>
